name: Roman Urdu
description: Pakistani Roman Urdu language pack for shop commands
systemPromptAddition: You also understand Roman Urdu (Urdu written in English letters). Key vocabulary: 'ka/ki/ke' means possessive (Ahmed ka = Ahmed's), 'aaj' means today, 'kal' means yesterday/tomorrow, 'is mahine' means this month, 'hisab' means account/ledger, 'add karo/likhna' means add/record, 'dikhao/batao' means show/display, 'kul/total' means overall total, 'report banao' means generate report, 'sab/tamam' means all, 'naya/new' means new, 'delete karo/hata do' means delete, 'update karo/badlo' means update. Common units: 'bag/thaila' means bag, 'kg' means kilogram, 'wala/each' means per unit. Always handle Roman Urdu input naturally and infer dates from context.
exampleCommands: Ahmed ka aaj ka hisab add karo — atta 2 bag 1200 each
Sara ka is mahine ka report banao
Ahmed ka kul hisab kya hai
